Cabin crew · United Kingdom

Nigel Ogden

British Airways Flight 53901990
Flight
British Airways Flight 5390
Date
10 June 1990
Aircraft
BAC One-Eleven
Location
Southampton
Survivors
87 of 87 aboard

When a cockpit windscreen blew out and the captain was pulled partly out of the aircraft, this flight attendant held on to him until the aircraft landed safely at Southampton.

Who helped

  • Alastair Atchison First officerTook control after the windscreen blew out, sent a mayday, descended the jet and landed it safely at Southampton while the crew held the captain.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • John Heward Chief steward (purser)Cleared the broken cockpit door from the controls and helped hold Captain Lancaster, taking over when Nigel Ogden tired.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Simon Rogers StewardStrapped himself into a cockpit seat and held Captain Lancaster by the ankles, relieving the exhausted Nigel Ogden until landing.Sources: 1 2 3 4

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Airways_Flight_5390 ↗
